about: Real screenshots of Ori for the pitch's media slots, standing in until Zuyu films the new clips. No video was generated, recorded or edited for these; each file is a browser screenshot of the running product (crops and downscaling only).
product: Ori built from this repository (product code at HEAD b8a1808; no local changes under client/src, server or shared), served on a throwaway local server and database in Sample mode (MODEL_PROVIDER=sample): scripted rules and a built-in catalog, no AI model, photos not read.
caption: Caption every still where sampleModeContent is true as 'Sample mode' (these are screenshots, not recordings). sampleModeLabelInFrame / exampleLabelInFrame say whether the product's own 'Sample mode' or 'Example' labels are visible inside the image.
account: One fresh account, signed up through the sign-up form (display name 'Zuyu'), used throughout like a person would: one Light app, one photo.
photo: server/fixtures/media/light-1.jpg (CC0, Fons Heijnsbroek, Wikimedia Commons; server/fixtures/media/sources.json). The product's own example photos come from the same CC0 set.
continuity: Same photo, thought ('I keep stopping for long shadows on brick walls in the late afternoon. I want to get better at noticing light on my walks.'), observation ('Low sun turns the brick wall gold'), request ('Add camera settings to my photo notes') and camera value ('Fuji X100V') as the existing clips 01 and 02. The focus words differ: 'Focus on golden-hour shadows' here, 'Focus on shadows and reflections' in clip 01.
journey: Signed up; Agent: attached the photo, typed the thought, sent.
Ori's Sample-mode reply proposed Light; Preview Light; typed 'Focus on golden-hour shadows' and pressed Update preview; Make mine; Ready; Open Light.
In Light: opened the photo entry, Edit, typed the observation, Save.
Edit with Ori: typed the request, Preview change, Apply change; then typed 'Fuji X100V' into the new Camera field and saved.
To retake the 'before' frames without a toast: the product's Undo (History, 'Undo last change'), the frames, then the same change applied again with Edit with Ori.
Settings > Bring context from your AI: Copy the prompt; pasted a hand-written summary labelled 'Example written for this demo'; Add it; What you've shared.
Playground (ideas made on the first visit): Preview Riff; Make mine; Riff's timer run 8 seconds, paused and reset (nothing saved).
Agent: shared 'Follow up with Maya Thursday about the proposal'; Preview People; Make mine; four fictional follow-ups typed by hand (two due today, two later this week).
My apps; optional: Course Assignments from the Playground with three fictional assignments typed by hand.
viewports: Phone stills: 390x844 CSS px at deviceScaleFactor 2 (780x1688 px), iPhone Safari user agent in Chromium. Desktop frames: 1280x800 CSS px at 2x, downscaled. Icons: the server's 512 px manifest PNGs, converted losslessly.
format: WebP (lossy q84 for screens, lossless for icons).
